components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one spruce action on a page, such as Create event or Sign in.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--accent, #0f5c4c); color: var(--accent-foreground, #f4fbf8); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4286; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #0c4a3d); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #0f5c4c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; background: var(--disabled, #ecebe7); color: var(--muted, #5c5c56); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cancel, retry, and Edit event. Sheet fill with a hairline rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #dddcd7); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--surface, #fcfcfb); color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4286; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--hover, #e6e6e2); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #0f5c4c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; background: var(--disabled, #ecebe7); color: var(--muted, #5c5c56); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: The confirming action inside a destructive dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--danger, #8d2f2f); color: var(--danger-foreground, #fff7f7); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4286; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-hover, #742626); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #0f5c4c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; background: var(--disabled, #ecebe7); color: var(--muted, #5c5c56); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled sheet field. Invalid fields take a Seal border and a Seal message.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); } .ds-input { height: 40px; width: 240px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #dddcd7); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--surface, #fcfcfb); color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); font: 400 0.875rem/1.4286 var(--font-sans, "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); caret-color: var(--accent, #0f5c4c); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #5c5c56); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #0f5c4c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input:disabled { background: var(--disabled, #ecebe7); } .ds-field-error { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--danger, #8d2f2f); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"], .ds-field:has(.ds-field-error) .ds-input { border-color: var(--danger, #8d2f2f); }

components.name: Primary Nav
components.description: Sidebar items on the galley slab. Active is Selected Sheet, not spruce.
components.html:
OverviewEvents
ADAdministratorAdministrator
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 224px; padding: 12px; background: var(--sidebar, #e9e9e6); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); color: var(--muted, #5c5c56); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4286; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: var(--hover, #e6e6e2); color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #0f5c4c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-link.is-active { background: var(--selected, #deded8); color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); font-weight: 500; } .ds-person { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #dddcd7); } .ds-avatar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--selected, #deded8); color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-person-name { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); } .ds-person-role { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #5c5c56); }

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: Draft, Active, and Archived. Only Active uses spruce.
components.html: DraftActiveArchived
components.css: .ds-stamps { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-stamp-draft { background: var(--selected, #deded8); color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); } .ds-stamp-active { background: var(--accent-soft, #e3f2ed); color: var(--accent, #0f5c4c); } .ds-stamp-archived { border: 1px solid var(--border, #dddcd7); color: var(--muted, #5c5c56); }

components.name: Specification
components.description: A ruled job specification. Labels are Proof Gray; values are ink.
components.css: .ds-spec { width: min(100%, 36rem); border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #dddcd7); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-spec-row { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #dddcd7); } .ds-spec-row dt { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted, #5c5c56); } .ds-spec-row dd { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4286; color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-spec-row { grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr; gap: 24px; } }

components.name: Tally
components.description: Three counts divided by hairlines. Figures are tabular display type.
components.css: .ds-tally { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); width: min(100%, 40rem); border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #dddcd7); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #dddcd7); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-tally > div { padding: 20px 16px; } .ds-tally > div + div { border-left: 1px solid var(--border, #dddcd7); } .ds-tally dt { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted, #5c5c56); } .ds-tally dd { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Confirmation on the sheet, with the overlay shadow and a scrim behind it.
components.html:
Delete this event?

This removes the event record.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(28rem, calc(100vw - 2rem)); padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #dddcd7); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); background: var(--surface, #fcfcfb); color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 1px 2px rgb(22 22 20 / 6%), 0 12px 28px rgb(22 22 20 / 8%)); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.4286; color: var(--muted, #5c5c56); } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; margin-top: 20px; } .ds-dialog-cancel, .ds-dialog-confirm { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 6px); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-dialog-cancel { border: 1px solid var(--border, #dddcd7); background: var(--surface, #fcfcfb); color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); } .ds-dialog-cancel:hover { background: var(--hover, #e6e6e2); } .ds-dialog-confirm { border: none; background: var(--danger, #8d2f2f); color: var(--danger-foreground, #fff7f7); } .ds-dialog-confirm:hover { background: var(--danger-hover, #742626); } .ds-dialog-cancel:focus-visible, .ds-dialog-confirm:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #0f5c4c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: ENTOURAGE lockup. Wide tracking stays on this name alone.
components.html: ENTOURAGEEvent Platform
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--foreground, #1c1c1a); font-family: var(--font-sans, "Geist Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-wordmark-name { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; } .ds-wordmark-sub { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #5c5c56); }

narrative.overview:
Entourage is a typesetter's galley for an event platform. The page is warm paper. Work sits on a slightly lighter sheet, separated by hairline rules, set in charcoal ink. One spruce accent is reserved for the primary action, the keyboard focus ring, the text caret, the selection wash, and the Active status stamp. Light and dark are the same structure: paper, sheet, rule, and ink stay apart in both themes.

Density is that of a desk tool. Page titles are one size. Body and labels share a single grotesque. Dates in tables and counts in the tally use tabular figures. Corners are 6px, with 4px only where a control sits inside a 6px track. Shadows appear on overlays — dialogs, menus, and toasts — and nowhere on the resting page.

The signed-in shell is a 248px sidebar and one content column. Lists are full-width tables. An opened event is a ruled specification, with unbuilt modules left in the rail as muted, non-interactive labels.
keyCharacteristics: Stepped warm-neutral ramp, with paper, sheet, rule, and ink kept apart in both themes
One spruce accent, plus a danger ramp kept for destructive actions and errors
Geist Sans at 400, 500, and 600, with tabular figures on table dates and tally counts
6px corners, 4px inset segments, and shadow only on overlays
A 248px sidebar and ruled specifications, not a card grid

rules.name: The Spruce Rule
rules.body: Spruce marks the primary action, the focus ring, the caret, the selection wash, and the Active stamp. It does not color navigation, tally numbers, or structure.

rules.name: The Separate Inks Rule
rules.body: Paper, sheet, rule, and ink are four different steps in both themes.

rules.name: The Seal Rule
rules.body: Destructive confirmation, invalid field borders, and error text use the danger ramp: Seal (#8d2f2f), Seal Deep (#742626), Seal Paper (#fff7f7), and Seal Wash (#f7e8e8) in light; Night Seal (#f0b4b4), Night Seal Lift (#f7cdcd), Night Seal Ink (#2a1010), and Night Seal Wash (#3c2222) in dark. Light seal deepens on hover. Dark seal lightens. This ramp is not a brand accent.

rules.name: The One Grotesque Rule
rules.body: Geist Sans carries every label, title, and count. The loaded weights are 400, 500, and 600.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Table dates and tally counts use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Wordmark Tracking Rule
rules.body: Letter-spacing of 0.16em belongs to the ENTOURAGE wordmark. Page titles and counts use -0.02em. All other text stays at normal tracking.

rules.name: The Galley Rule
rules.body: The signed-in frame is a fixed 248px sidebar and a single column capped at 72rem. Below 768px the sidebar becomes an overlay drawer.

rules.name: The Overlay Shadow Rule
rules.body: The shadow token is for dialogs, menus, and toasts. Resting pages, tables, the sidebar, and specification rows are flat.

rules.name: The Six Pixel Rule
rules.body: Controls, stamps, dialogs, menus, and choice rows use a 6px corner. Segments nested inside a 6px track use 4px.

dos: Do keep spruce on the primary action, the 2px focus ring at 2px offset, the caret, the selection wash, and the Active stamp.
Do divide tally counts and specification rows with a 1px rule.
Do set tabular numerals on table dates and tally counts.
Do leave unbuilt event modules in the rail, muted and not links, with the line "Not built yet".
Do collapse motion when reduced motion is requested. Color transitions are 150ms, the page fade is 160ms from opacity 0.72 to 1, and the mobile drawer is 200ms.
donts: Don't structure a page as a card grid or as icon-and-number tiles.
Don't put the overlay shadow on a resting surface.
Don't introduce a second brand hue. Destructive actions and field errors use the danger ramp only.
Don't add a second type family or apply the wordmark's 0.16em tracking to any other text.
Don't use gradients, glass, neon, or decorative motion.
